• Located in the heart of a charming town of Ballyjamesduff in South Cavan and close to the Cavan/Meath border.
  • This period mid-terrace property is a delightful blend of traditional charm and modern convenience.
  • Boasting two retail units on the ground floor with adjoining self contained living accommodation.
  • The living accommodation boasts three bedrooms, two reception rooms, and two bathrooms, this property offers ample space for comfortable living.
  • The 2 retail units are currently operating as established hairdressers.
  • As mentioned the property is a mix of commercial and residential accommodation that can easily be modified to provide additional space for either designation with such potential for conversion into residential apartments a real possibility.
  • Thus the property retains an attractive rental yield in its present form and potential conversion.
  • The premises also retains a large yard to the rear which is access via rear alleyway for convenience.
  • With the said yard are two expansive sheds which provide further potential for commercial use.
  • With convenient access to local amenities, schools, and transport links, this home is ideal for families or investors looking for spacious accommodation within easy reach of urban conveniences.
  • Don't miss the opportunity to make this charming property your own and enjoy a quintessential countryside lifestyle in a vibrant community.
  • Contact us today to arrange a viewing and discover the endless possibilities this wonderful home has to offer.
